title: Infrastructure environment taxonomy and separation
workflow: Select regulated institution and jurisdiction constraints
Classify each proposed environment and its processing purpose
Design segregated network, identity, key and data boundaries
Define data masking and synthetic fixture restrictions
Assign operations/security owners and provisioning approval
Verify isolation and record environment inventory
invariants: No production customer records in unapproved test environment
Production signing keys cannot be reused in development
DR environment must preserve controlled accounting recovery semantics
Production external rail credentials are barred from nonproduction
Tenant scope enforced at service and network boundaries
Environment activation requires qualified legal and security authorization
planned_tests: Sandbox endpoint cannot send production settlement
approval_gate: Institution hosting and sovereignty policy, network/IAM signoff and isolation test evidence.
